deploybot: [DEPLOY START] environment=production release=2026.03.20-rc3 tag=release/v1.14.0 commit=1a2b3c4d author=Evan Park <https://git.redwood/evan/commits/1a2b3c4d> PR=<https://git.redwood/evan/pulls/4821> change-window=2026-03-20T02:00Z-04:00Z notes='kv-cache hotfix + batching tweak' rollout=canary(5%) -> gradual.
sarah: acked. smoke tests passed in staging earlier. will watch latency dashboards.
ev an: staging metrics looked stable, canary started 3m ago. logs show no obvious errors.
tyler: heads up — EU region had a brief infra blip earlier, might affect cross-region fallbacks. keep an eye on 99p latency.
deploybot: [CANARY UPDATE] commit=1a2b3c4d canary=5% health=ok traces=ok errors=0 latency_p95=210ms
jamal: seeing small spike on p99 for model-serving in prod-east, correlating with long KV miss for a shard. spike started ~2m after canary.
evan: rolling back canary? or pin to previous runtime build while we investigate? previous prod commit=9f8e7d6c (author=Priya) was stable.
sarah: if we rollback, we should pin the release tag to avoid auto-rollout.
tyler: +1 pin, then we can re-run canary with an adjusted batching config.
jamal: agree. Recommend rollback to 9f8e7d6c and pin tag release/v1.13.9 for now.
deploybot: [ROLLBACK INITIATED] target_commit=9f8e7d6c author=Priya Shah <https://git.redwood/priya/commits/9f8e7d6c> action=rollback reason='p99 spike KV miss' command=`kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-serving --to-revision=9f8e7d6c`
evan: executing rollback and pinning tag now. will update once complete.
deploybot: [ROLLBACK COMPLETE] environment=production rolled_back_to=9f8e7d6c duration=2m35s notes='tag pinned release/v1.13.9 to prevent re-rollout'
sarah: monitoring — dashboards look back to baseline. thanks team.
tyler: we'll re-evaluate batching change in a new PR and coordinate another change window after root cause.
jamal: filing postmortem on KV shard miss, adding perf test for worst-case KV miss to CI.
evan: created follow-up PR <https://git.redwood/evan/pulls/4825> with conservative batching and retry, targeting next change window.
sarah: closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
